items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: I mean, Willie B. Thomas and his wife was there

ctx.x: Where did you play? Sir? Where did you play?
That was in the French 70s, wasn't it? French Quarter. Yes, the French Quarter. Oh, yeah. I mean, Willie B. Thomas and his wife was there, and that fella played at Harmonita. Is he from New Orleans?
Knows this fella played at Harmonita. He lived there in Baton Rouge.
